# Bahaal

> Bahaal is a volunteer-led project based in Gujranwala, Pakistan, started in 2024. It repairs water pumps and leaks, and installs low-cost solar and biogas systems, for low-income and elderly families who would otherwise go without. The team is made up of 7 student engineers and volunteers who have served 48 homes and 4 community parks so far.

The site documents how the project finds families in need through word of mouth, what work the team does and does not take on, and the before-and-after cost data collected for each fix.

## Pages

- [Home](https://bahaalgrw.site/): project overview, mission, and summary numbers.
- [Our Approach](https://bahaalgrw.site/approach/): how families are found, the team's process, and example entries from the home service log.
- [Impact](https://bahaalgrw.site/impact/): homes and parks served, funds raised, and example before-and-after utility bill data.
- [Privacy Policy](https://bahaalgrw.site/privacy/): what data this site collects and how to ask questions about it.
